description: Format raw changelog bullets into the project's release-note line format.

evals.name: mixed-types-grouped-in-order
evals.prompt:
Format these release notes:
- feature: Add dark mode toggle (#12)
- bug: Fix crash on empty input (#7)
- docs: Update install guide (#20)
- refactor: Split parser module (#31)
- bug: Fix typo in error message (#8)
- feature: Add CSV export (#15)
evals.expected_output: Lines grouped FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE, keeping input order within each group, each formatted as '- [TYPE] Summary (#id)': two FEAT lines (dark mode, CSV export), two FIX lines (empty input crash, typo), one DOCS line, one CHORE line (refactor mapped to CHORE).

evals.name: missing-issue-number-renders-none
evals.prompt:
Format these release notes:
- feature: Add search filter (#42)
- bug: Fix flaky login test
evals.expected_output: '- [FEAT] Add search filter (#42)' followed by '- [FIX] Fix flaky login test (#none)'; the bullet without an issue number gets (#none).
